name: 1 good thing
description:
Some days feel too small to remember. 1 good thing is where you keep them anyway.

Draw one good thing, in seconds. Drop it in the jar.

name: ArtMyVibe
description: Most galleries sort by artist, date and school. This one sorts by feeling — describe a mood, or just type what’s on your mind, and it finds the paintings that fit. Over 10,000 public-domain paintings.

name: Been there
description: A collection of places you’ve been to or called home, told through embroidered patches.

name: Chute
description: Turn your Mac's notch into a super fast Airdrop portal to your iPhone.

name: Huddlekit
description: Website feedback tool

name: Iris
description: A tool for extracting colours from an image.

name: Lunagraph
description: Full-featured design canvas that runs on code. Design, explore, refine by hand, then hand off the whole experience. States, interactions, and flows, all as React code.

name: Porcelain tic-tac-toe
description: A browser-based porcelain atelier where you paint one quarter of a tic-tac-toe board, let symmetry complete it, then turn the digital design into a handmade ceramic piece.

name: Resurf
description: One place for your ideas, references, and inspiration.

name: Rows
description: its not mine (i didnt build it) im just a big fan. yall should also check out respiro by @sgnoogle (such GREAT design OMFG)

name: Type Foundry Directory
description: An index of type foundries organized to help demystify font licensing and make searching for type easier.

name: TypeStax
description: TypeStax is a type scale builder for designers working on design systems, that feels like vintage audio hardware.

name: Bekadoo
description: A Pomodoro timer with ambient scenes and white noise. Choose a city and setting, set a focus session from 5 to 60 minutes, and add music from YouTube or Spotify.
shortInfo: Focus timer with ambient scenes and white noise

name: Colors & Fonts
description: Build color palettes, test contrast, pair fonts, and create mesh gradients and shaders. Export the results for use in your designs.
shortInfo: Color palettes, font pairings, and contrast tools

name: doppio
description: Create motion pieces from templates in a dedicated editor. Add your designs and adjust the template controls to make animated presentations of your work.
shortInfo: Motion templates for presenting design work

name: FlingWords
description: Type words and fling them around the screen. This iPhone toy uses physics to make letters bounce and collide.
shortInfo: Turn typed words into bouncing letters

name: FlipNote
description: Send messages from your phone to a shared split-flap display on a TV, tablet, or browser. Create a board for notes and reminders at home, at work, or at an event.
shortInfo: Shared split-flap message boards

name: Frownie
description: A Mac menu bar app that detects when you frown and reminds you to relax your forehead.
shortInfo: Mac reminders to relax your forehead

name: Hands Time
description: Clock widgets for iPhone with a choice of themes and visual styles.
shortInfo: Customizable clock widgets for iPhone

name: Mac Harmonium
description: Play harmonium notes in your browser with the A through J keys. Drag the bellows with your mouse, or use the lid sensor on a compatible MacBook to pump air.
shortInfo: Play a harmonium with your keyboard and MacBook lid

name: Make Your Own Breakfast
description: Browse breakfast recipes shared by the community. The iOS app suggests meals using the ingredients you have.
shortInfo: Community recipes and ingredient-based meal ideas

name: Mat
description: Arrange photo cutouts and stickers on a digital cutting mat, then display your collage as a Home Screen widget.
shortInfo: Photo collages for your Home Screen

name: Momotaro: App Blocker
description: Set a focus timer that blocks distracting apps during a session. Complete sessions to unlock additional color themes.
shortInfo: Focus timer with app blocking and unlockable themes

name: Oddflick
description: Discover classic films through short clips, then tap to watch the full movie. Browse by genre or decade, save a watchlist, and resume where you left off. Available for iPhone.
shortInfo: Discover classic films through swipeable clips

name: Odorne
description: Browse homes from around the world and find the furniture, lighting, and other products featured in each room.
shortInfo: Find the products featured in real homes

name: Pixelmon
description: A browser game with Game Boy-style graphics where you play as a designer, product manager, or engineer and battle for buy-in.
shortInfo: An office role-playing game in a Game Boy world

name: Powst
description: Find UK businesses by type and location, design a postcard, and send it by post. Preview the design and price before checkout.
shortInfo: Design and mail postcards to UK businesses

name: rotation
description: Explore music charts on an interactive globe. Select a country or city to hear what is playing there, or follow curated routes across regions.
shortInfo: Explore music charts on an interactive globe

name: Toolcraft
description: An open-source starter kit and UI library for building design apps with AI. Use its components to create creative tools, internal utilities, and interactive experiments.
shortInfo: Starter kit and UI components for design apps

name: Uni
description: A desktop assistant for macOS and Windows that answers questions, transcribes speech, and provides quick actions from a panel near your cursor.
shortInfo: Desktop answers, speech transcription, and quick actions

name: Jelly Dice
description: Roll one to five squishy 3D dice in your browser. Choose from six jelly styles, tap a die to poke it, or drag to stretch it before rolling.
shortInfo: Poke, pull, and roll squishy virtual dice

name: Archiv
description: A collection app for identifying and organizing objects from the world around you. Turn photos of everyday finds into a visual archive, browse by category, and adjust the collection grid to suit your view.
shortInfo: Make a visual archive of the physical world

name: DialKit
description: Add a control panel to your React project and adjust motion, layout, colors, and other values in real time. Use sliders, toggles, and presets to explore variations while seeing the result directly in your interface.
shortInfo: Tune interface details with live controls

name: Loot
description: Photograph something you love and Loot identifies it, removes the background, and adds it to a collection. Organize everyday finds, collect with friends, and share collections or export them as posters from your iPhone.
shortInfo: Turn everyday finds into photo collections

name: Murmur
description: An open-source collection of animated glass orbs for AI interfaces, with web and SwiftUI versions. Explore visual styles, tune their appearance, and switch between states such as listening, thinking, and responding.
shortInfo: Shape responsive glass orbs for AI interfaces

name: Pica
description: A free, native macOS font manager with custom collections, logo and color previews, and one-click font activation. Explore OpenType features, watch folders for new fonts, and work with Chinese, Japanese, and Korean type.
shortInfo: Organize and preview your fonts on Mac

name: Weather OS
description: An interactive weather simulator for shaping clouds, storms, fog and snow with tactile controls, turning a full-screen sky into a playful study of atmospheric motion.
shortInfo: Shape a living sky with tactile controls

name: Letters of Love
description: A weekend project reviving the art of the love letter: a small, beautifully typeset collection of notes across time, made to inspire writing to your beloved.
shortInfo: Collection of love letters across time

name: Use Shelf
description: A browser extension that sends links and selected text from Chrome or Safari to a private Telegram bot chat in one click, keeping saved references where you already collect them.
shortInfo: Save links without losing context

name: The Good Invoice
description: A live invoice builder for freelancers and small studios, with editable client details, line items, taxes, notes, display options, logo upload and polished PDF export.
shortInfo: Build a polished invoice and export it as PDF

name: Annual Report Archive
description: An archive of 3,000+ annual reports from 1945–1991, revealing how companies once brought serious design, illustration, and artistry to their most ordinary publication.
shortInfo: 3,000+ annual reports from 1945–1991

name: Clocks
description: A customizable time and weather display for iPhone and iPad, pairing 13 clock styles with 28+ animated backgrounds as a daytime alternative to Apple’s StandBy mode.
shortInfo: A more fun standby mode

name: Visitors
description: A revenue-first analytics service combining realtime traffic, visitor journeys, performance insights and funnels with privacy-friendly tracking and integrated payment attribution.
shortInfo: Connect traffic, journeys and revenue

name: ASCIInator
description: A browser-based ASCII art generator that turns uploaded images into adjustable text compositions, with custom character ramps, sampling and tone controls, plus PNG, SVG and TXT export.
shortInfo: Generate precisely tuned ASCII visuals

name: Whenever Works
description: A lightweight group-scheduling tool for creating date and time polls, sharing one link, collecting availability without accounts, and seeing which option works for the most people.
shortInfo: Group scheduling without the back-and-forth

name: Slowday
description: A social city-discovery app that turns Instagram, TikTok and Google Maps links into saved places, building a personal map shaped by curators whose taste you trust.
shortInfo: Turn social finds into a map of places

name: Shake it to Shape it
description: A playful browser tool for generating geometric SVGs from randomized shapes, colors and styles, then copying or downloading the result for interfaces, identities and visual work.
shortInfo: Generate polished SVG shapes

name: Snackgood
description: A playful community snack guide where friends share fun, healthier finds with photos, stores and personal notes, turning everyday recommendations into a browsable visual collection.
shortInfo: Fun, healthier snacks from friends

name: DJR Glyphs
description: An interactive navigator through David Jonathan Ross’s type library for browsing individual glyphs across families, characters and variable-font instances, with links to each typeface.
shortInfo: Every DJR glyph in one place

name: Humanoid Index
description: A research index for browsing and comparing humanoid robots by company, country, dimensions, mobility, capabilities, price and production status, with detailed machine profiles.
shortInfo: Compare humanoid robots in production

name: Build Your Own Singaporean
description: A modular builder with local hairstyles, clothing, objects, skin tones and brand colours, helping anyone create distinctly Singaporean characters and scenes without design software.
shortInfo: Create distinctly Singaporean characters and scenes

name: Tracing Paper
description: A browser-based tracing workspace for layering reference images beneath translucent sheets, with grids, reveal regions and opacity controls for drawing studies and warmups.
shortInfo: Digital tracing paper for studies and warmups

name: BuilderTools
description: A curated showcase of experimental tools for designers and developers, documenting what each tool makes, the controls it offers and the independent builder behind it.
shortInfo: Free browser tools for design assets

name: Silt
description: silt is the blackboard for designers who design in code: the real component, running and clickable, with every version and the session that made it kept together. a place, not a link.
shortInfo: The blackboard for designers who design in code

name: Katalog
description: A social journal for logging, rating and discussing films, TV, books, albums and games in one place, with cross-format search, lists and Letterboxd or StoryGraph imports.
shortInfo: One journal for films, books, albums and games

name: Curated Supply
description: A design-led directory of more than 1,000 useful, well-made objects across workspace, carry, coffee, audio and home, selected for material quality, utility and lasting design.
shortInfo: Thoughtfully curated, well-made objects

name: Warpbnb
description: A playful time-travel marketplace for browsing vacation rentals from ancient Egypt to a future Mars colony, with stays organized by theme, era and guest count.
shortInfo: Book a stay anywhere in time

name: Asterism
description: A Figma plugin for browsing Are.na without leaving the design canvas, bringing channels and visual references into the place where designers are already working.
shortInfo: Browse Are.na without leaving Figma

name: Lyba
description: A review layer for Framer sites that lets clients pin comments directly to the live page, keeps feedback tied to exact screen sizes and records final approval.
shortInfo: A review layer for Framer sites

name: Akuko Labs
description: An independent keyboard studio developing complete mechanical keyboards and keycap sets shaped by Bauhaus, photography and playful color, with projects ranging from Gestalt to Motif65.
shortInfo: Thoughtfully designed keyboard projects

name: Tracky
description: A playful project-management workspace for freelancers, combining project tracking with a notebook-style interface and a roadmap for tasks, to-dos, custom tables, reports and invoicing.
shortInfo: Project management that feels hand-drawn

name: DeskSlope
description: A webcam-controlled 3D snowboarding game with a global leaderboard: lean to steer, crouch to brake, or play with arrow keys.
shortInfo: Snowboard with your webcam

name: Ziney
description: Pick your paper and make a zine: an artsy browser zine editor with a public library of finished issues.
shortInfo: An artsy zine editor and library

name: World Time Bestie
description: Plan across timezones by dragging city rows against a shared timeline, with date ranges and quick adds for every city you work with.
shortInfo: A drag-to-plan timezone tracker

name: Cafe Pomodoro
description: Order a drink, settle in, and focus: a pomodoro timer dressed up as a cozy café, complete with ambient sound.
shortInfo: A cozy café pomodoro timer

name: Ciggie Index
description: Enter a city and hours spent outside to see your local air quality translated into cigarettes smoked.
shortInfo: See your air quality in cigarettes

name: Shrump
description: A webcam-powered posture nagger that catches you mid-slouch.
shortInfo: Your webcam knows when you slouch

name: Weatherbunny
description: An outfit helper that tells you what to wear for today's weather, so you never over- or under-dress again.
shortInfo: Dress for the weather, cutely

name: Design Your Sunset
description: A sunset-gradient generator for designers: tune warmth, glow and haze with live presets, then copy the CSS or download your wallpaper at desktop, tablet, or phone sizes.
shortInfo: Design sunset gradients you can export

name: Nostalgic Snacks
description: A draggable, explorable museum of Malaysia's most nostalgic snacks, from White Rabbit Candy to Haw Flakes, with photos, details, and a "where's mine?" submission flow.
shortInfo: An interactive museum of nostalgic snacks

name: ShaderGradient
description: Create living, animated gradients and drop them straight into Figma, Framer, or your React app. Tune shape, colors and motion on the web, then ship them anywhere.
shortInfo: Beautiful moving gradients for your designs

name: Textures
description: Drop in any image and run it through 25 tactile filters, from Risograph to Cyanotype, then download the result at full resolution. Free, instant, no signup.
shortInfo: Tactile image filters in your browser

name: Color Shift
description: Pull color inspiration from randomly loaded Unsplash photos and check every background and foreground pairing live against WCAG and APCA contrast standards. A free iOS companion from Shift Nudge, the interface design training by Matt D. Smith.
shortInfo: Color inspiration with live contrast checks

name: Zoah
description: A collaborative platform for designing, versioning, and publishing code components from a visual canvas, with branching, diffs, merging, and AI. Formerly Opacity. Currently accepting waitlist signups.
shortInfo: Collaborative design and code on one canvas

name: Orbkit
description: A React library of WebGL shader orbs for AI and voice interfaces. Preview idle, thinking, and speaking states, tune each orb in the playground, and install components through the shadcn registry to customize them in your own project.
shortInfo: Add reactive shader orbs to AI interfaces

name: Holo Sticker
description: A Figma plugin that turns selected layers into holographic stickers. Choose tinted, rainbow, glitter, or foil finishes, adjust the shimmer and die-cut edges, and add the result back to your file as an image. Supports multiple layers at once.
shortInfo: Turn Figma layers into holographic stickers

name: Drawably
description: A lightweight library of hand-drawn UI controls for React and plain JavaScript. Buttons, inputs, cards, and text decorations generate fresh pen sketches, with subtle CSS animation and real form controls underneath.
shortInfo: Hand-drawn UI controls with a fresh pen sketch
